lines.text: Quick vibe check: is this music okay?

data.define: A quick moment to see how someone feels or if a place feels good.

example.text: Quick vibe check: is this music okay?

misuse.text: Don't run a 'vibe check' on your teacher.
misuse.why: It's casual and could sound rude.

publish.title: What does "vibe check" mean?
publish.value: Vibe check = Checking someone's mood or energy. Example: "Quick vibe check: is this music okay?" (very casual English, US).
